item.title: Show HN: Mstat a temperature and stat tracker for macOS in Zig and SwiftUI
item.summary: Turns out it's weirdly hard to quickly check cpu temp on M series macs so whipped this up, also has cpu usage, memory, and lets you show multiple or just an icon for the popover. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49158573 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
